name: same100-oof-full-normal-vs-K8-truth-assisted-diagnostic
status: Preregistered before any full-normal truth-target processing or native score; this diagnostic does not reopen the failed K8 learner gate
question: Did discarding normal-displacement Fourier modes above K8 remove scorer-relevant local contour detail, or does the fixed additive/profile operation have too little score headroom even with all 512 true normal components on these OOF TRAIN shots?

construction.scope: Only the identical first100 original-TRAIN fold0-OOF shots and all their 21,667 full frames from the old K8 pilot. Their true scorer-native LCFS may be read for this truth-assisted diagnostic. The internal gate200, original evaluation tail70 and public shots may not be read or scored. No new model is fitted.
construction.same_normal_target: Use the same scorer-native source/true 512-point contours, canonical max-R source roll, minimum-squared cyclic true correspondence and outward unit physical normal. Let d_i=((C_true_matched_i-C_pred_i) dot n_i). The existing K8 arm reconstructs d from Fourier DC plus modes1..8. The new arm retains d_i for ALL 512 points and sets u_i=d_i*n_i, rolled back into original scorer indexing. Do not insert tangential displacement or the full 2D matched C_true−C_pred vector.
construction.same_map_and_profile: Use the unchanged old correct_map_from_displacement: every-eighth TPS control, axis and edge anchors, boundary taper, Gaussian contour shell fixed at two minimum grid spacings, lambda1 and float32 output. Apply the same fixed nine-a spatial interior source-li compensation targeting li of the ORIGINAL source ψ, never true li. No width, lambda, TPS, profile grid, fallback, smoothing, weight, frame or shot changes.
construction.preflight: Hash and verify old campaign, artifact, source NPZ, native source JSON, K8 result and pinned profile family. Verify exact100 ordered filenames/frame counts, each parquet size/SHA and no overlap with gate200/tail70. Freeze an isolated source snapshot and all hashes before touching true LCFS. Abort on missing/nonfinite contour or malformed map with shot/frame context, without dropping a frame.

scoring_and_readout.native_scorer: Score the one newly sealed full-normal float32 NPZ through the untouched pinned local_score on exactly the old100 ordered files. Reuse the byte-pinned source native JSON as matched control; it scored the exact same source NPZ and filenames with that scorer. Report S, R2psi, R2qb, raw D_LCFS, Consistency, all seven functional R2, failure fractions, full-normal per-shot max/p95 normal movement and stage times. Submitted q95/betaN arrays must be byte-identical to the old source.
scoring_and_readout.comparison: Report full-minus-source native S beside the already measured K8-minus-source +0.000438 on the same100. Compare both to the original +0.002600 K8 investment margin only as a diagnostic yardstick, not a new go gate or retroactive rescue of K8.
scoring_and_readout.interpretation: If the full-normal arm also misses +0.002600, this fixed normal/additive/profile family has insufficient investment headroom on these OOF TRAIN shots. If full-normal substantially exceeds K8, high-frequency normal detail matters for this family; any learned 512-target model needs a separate preregistered capacity/cost study. Neither outcome guarantees a public-fold effect or authorizes folds1-4, learner fitting, tail70 scoring or submission.

resource_estimate_not_measurement: One full-normal map/profile build should be on the order of the measured K8 build 757.45s on CPU24, plus about 69s native score and source snapshot/preflight. Record actual wall and concurrency; keep process group/log watchable.
